developments.title: FOMC Raises Fed Funds Rate 25 bps to 3.75%-4.00%
developments.fact: Federal Reserve unanimously votes 12-0 to raise policy rate by 25 bps, marking first rate increase since 2023 with year-end projection at 4.10%.
developments.interpretation: Elevates discount rate on speculative tech while boosting interest yields on exchange collateral and stablecoin fiat reserves.

developments.title: Spot Bitcoin Defends $76,000 Base Rebounding to $80,736
developments.fact: Bitcoin absorbed immediate post-hike dip to $75,586 and rebounded above $80,700, remaining up 19.9% month-over-month.
developments.interpretation: Confirms structural buyer demand and monetary inelasticity above fundamental cost support levels.

developments.title: Strategy Bitcoin Purchases Decelerate to 520 BTC as Cash Reserves Reach $1.4B
developments.fact: Strategy expanded holdings to 847,363 BTC with a $35M buy (520 BTC at $67,068 average), while boosting USD cash reserves to $1.4B.
developments.interpretation: Reflects tighter debt market conditions and prudent capital preservation amidst higher borrowing costs.

developments.title: CME Group Digital Asset Volume and Open Interest Reach All-Time Highs
developments.fact: CME recorded over 34,200 open contracts across institutional BTC/ETH futures while sustaining operating margins above 58%.
developments.interpretation: Institutional rotation favors regulated, cleared financial infrastructure over unhedged balance sheet speculation.

developments.title: Coinbase Q2 Subscription Revenue Climbs to 48% of Net Revenue
developments.fact: Coinbase generated $555M in subscription and services revenue out of $1.20B total, driven by stablecoin reserve yields and institutional custody.
developments.interpretation: Fed rate hike at 3.75%-4.00% supports stablecoin interest income, dampening spot transaction cyclicality.

developments.title: IREN Ltd Energizes 2.8 GW Power Pipeline with HPC Expansion
developments.fact: IREN reported 35 EH/s hash rate capacity while contracting multi-hundred megawatt data center facilities for AI cloud workloads at <$0.038/kWh.
developments.interpretation: Dual-revenue compute model insulates infrastructure operators from standalone Bitcoin mining difficulty shocks.

developments.title: Senate Delays CLARITY Act Floor Vote
developments.fact: Digital asset market structure legislation stalled in Senate negotiations ahead of mid-term election calendar.
developments.interpretation: Extends compliance advantage for regulated incumbents (CME, registered broker-dealers) over unregulated platforms.

publication.headline: Bitcoin Thesis Rebalanced: Monetizing Higher Rates via Market Rails as Warsh Fed Lifts Target to 4.00%
publication.summary: Following the FOMC's 25 bps rate hike on September 16, spot Bitcoin holds firm above $76,000 while market rails (CME) and stablecoin cash custodians (COIN) emerge as premier risk-adjusted entries over leveraged balance sheet proxies.
